releaseNotes:
Hubble 2.0.16 keeps feedback preferences editable and makes Cancel immediate.

- Feedback colors remain visible and editable when feedback is disabled across
  router, CCC, Cyanview RCP, DIT Browse, LightEncode, and TSL actions. TSL glow
  preferences also remain editable while feedback is off.
- Cancel immediately restores the previous Button ID or button type and returns
  you to editing while the change saves in the background.
- Consecutive edits stay ordered, and failed cancellations preserve unrelated
  edits while restoring the confirmation for retry.

The installer includes the updated official module packages. Existing workspace
data and module update policies are preserved. This update is optional.
